agent: registry-variants, loop 35 wave A -> wave C handoff
why_no_worker_change_publish: All 16 variants were published in wave A as stdio-only mcpb rows (data/organic_variant_probes.json). A hosted variant is NOT publishable without a worker edit for two independent reasons: (1) remote/src/index.ts routes /^\/mcp\/([a-z-]+)$/ through the SERVERS table keyed by exact name, so /mcp/<alias> 404s today (negative control run 2026-09-12: POST /mcp/invoice-generator initialize -> 404); (2) the registry rejects a second server row that reuses the parent's remote URL (400 'remote URL ... is already used', measured NAMING_R2, CLAUDE.md trap 9), so the variant cannot just point at /mcp/<parent>.

hunks.where: immediately after the closing `};` of `const SERVERS: Record<string, ServerCfg> = { ... }` (the literal ends near line 635 in the loop-35 baseline)
hunks.add:
/* Loop 35 phrase-variant registry aliases (docs/VARIANTS_LOOP35.md). The official
 * registry binds one hosted URL to exactly one server name, so every published variant
 * name needs its own /mcp/<alias> path. An alias resolves to its parent BEFORE `product`
 * is used anywhere, so license checks (verifyLicense is per-product), tenant documents,
 * buy links and free caps are byte-identical to the parent endpoint. The aliases are NOT
 * inserted into SERVERS, so ENDPOINT_URLS, SERVER_COUNT and the /mcp index are unchanged. */
const VARIANT_ALIASES: Record<string, string> = {
  "invoice-generator": "invoice",
  "freelance-invoice": "invoice",
  "merge-pdf": "pdf",
  "split-pdf": "pdf",
  "time-tracking": "time-tracker",
  "timesheets": "time-tracker",
  "business-expenses": "expense-tracker",
  "mileage-tracker": "expense-tracker",
  "spreadsheet-builder": "spreadsheet",
  "spreadsheet-generator": "spreadsheet",
  "currency-exchange": "currency",
  "exchange-rates": "currency",
  "quote-template": "quotes",
  "estimate-template": "quotes",
  "bank-statement-pdf": "bank-statement",
  "categorize-transactions": "bank-statement",
};

hunks.where: the endpoint lookup (near line 1959-1961 in the loop-35 baseline). The /t/<token> form is already stripped back to /mcp/<name> above this point (line ~1848), so this one change covers header, query and path token forms.

patch_notes: Do NOT add the alias keys into SERVERS itself: ENDPOINT_URLS maps Object.keys(SERVERS) into the /mcp index 'endpoints' list and the hosted-endpoints KPI counts real servers; aliases would double-count.

Because product is canonicalized before authenticate(), an MCPL1 key signed for 'invoice' works on /mcp/invoice-generator (per-product license check would otherwise 401 it), and the tenant data document is the parent's, so data is shared rather than stranded.
No TOOLS entry is needed for aliases: TOOLS is only read by indexDoc's hardcoded server list, not per-request.
endpointPage/publicEndpointDoc will render the PARENT name on the alias URL for tokenless GET health checks - honest and deliberate.
routing_patch.post_deploy_verify: for each slug: initialize POST -> 200; tools/call without token -> 401; /mcp/whoami unchanged; then `node scripts/validate.mjs` once no deploy is mid-flight (trap 8).
